title: Transported ordinary tensor model and augmentation identities
statement: The K-flat resolution construction extends an ordinary tensor model to arbitrary second complexes and satisfies its restriction and augmentation transport identities.

proof.text: Apply the common K-flat roof theorem to the identity of each second complex. Its first augmentation supplies a native ordinary K-flat resolution. Work in the homotopy category, where quasi-isomorphisms have a right calculus of fractions.

For fixed native K-flat P, the actual ordinary total tensor functor followed by Q factors through homotopy classes, since tensoring a homotopy gives a homotopy. If q is a quasi-isomorphism, its cone is acyclic. Native K-flatness makes the tensor of this cone acyclic, and the tensor-cone isomorphism identifies it with the cone of the tensor map. Thus the tensor map is a quasi-isomorphism and its localization is invertible.

The source functor is derived tensor with the fixed localized P and therefore inverts quasi-isomorphisms. Apply the supplied K-flat naturality with the identity of P to obtain a natural comparison on the resolving objects. Extend its hom by the resolving-class comparison theorem. At an arbitrary object, naturality along a K-flat resolving quasi-isomorphism expresses the extended component as a product of three isomorphisms, so the comparison is an isomorphism.

Take the components of this natural isomorphism as extendedModel. Its restriction to K-flat objects is the restriction equation of the resolving-class extension. Naturality along any augmentation from a K-flat object, followed by that restriction equation, is exactly the required transport equation.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary tensor resolution transport via the existing resolving-class descent theorem and the tensor-cone comparison (Stacks Tags 06YS, 06YU, 06YJ).

lean.statement: theorem native_ordinary_tensor_model_resolution_transport (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u}) (H : (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))ᵒᵖ × DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y)) (S : CoefficientClosedStructure H) (model : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (_ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P), S.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q)) (hkflat : ∀ (P Q P' Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hP' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P') (hQ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q) (hQ' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q') (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q'), S.tensor.map (X := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) (Y := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q', DerivedCategory.Q.obj P')) (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map g) (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)) ≫ (model P' Q' hP').hom = (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y) (.up ℤ))) : ∃ extendedModel : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (_ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P), S.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q), (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hQ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q), extendedModel P Q hP = model P Q hP) ∧ (∀ (P Q K : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ) (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hK : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y K) (q : K ⟶ Q) (hq : QuasiIso q), S.tensor.map (X := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) (Y := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map q) (𝟙 _)) ≫ (extendedModel P Q hP).hom = (model P K hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P) q (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y) (.up ℤ)))
